fixes.stale: Your site changed after you previewed this, so nothing was applied. Review the preview below and apply again.
fixes.failed: The change could not be made, and your site was left as it was.
fixes.live.unknown: This module could not look at your site to check. Open the page in a private window to see what visitors get.
fixes.live.named_cache: {cache} is caching this site's pages. It was asked to clear them. If the change is still not live, clear it there.
fixes.undo.superseded: A later change, or an edit made by hand, has replaced what this change wrote. Undoing it now would overwrite that newer work, so nothing was changed.
fixes.undo.already: This change has already been undone.
fixes.undo.not_found: That change is not in the list, so nothing was changed.
fixes.reason.search_engines_discouraged: This site asks search engines not to index it (Settings, then Reading), so WordPress serves a robots.txt that shuts every crawler out. Change that setting first.
fixes.reason.subdirectory_site: This is a subdirectory site in a network. One robots.txt is served for the whole network, so this site cannot change it.
fixes.reason.both_seo_tools: Yoast SEO and Rank Math are both active, and each prints a structured data graph. Turn one of them off first, so this module does not guess which should carry the facts.
fixes.reason.choices_incomplete: Choose an answer for each of the three questions before applying.
fixer.robots_txt.affects: Every crawler and visitor that requests robots.txt on this site.
fixer.robots_txt.wont: It never edits a robots.txt file on your server, and it never changes a rule that is not a whole-site block on the crawlers you pick.
fixer.llms_txt.affects: Anyone or anything that requests /llms.txt on this site.
fixer.llms_txt.wont: It never lists drafts, private or password-protected pages, pages marked noindex or pages left out of the sitemap, and it never writes a file to your server.
fixer.robots_directives.affects: The robots meta tag on pages whose directives WordPress or your theme set.
fixer.robots_directives.wont: It never touches noindex, nofollow or a setting made on one page, and it never changes a directive set by an SEO plugin or by your server.
fixer.dates.affects: The dates in your sitemap and in your structured data.
fixer.dates.wont: It never rewrites a date stored in WordPress, and it never uses today's date as the date of a page.
fixer.entity_graph.affects: The structured data printed on every page of the site.
fixer.entity_graph.wont: It never guesses a fact about your organization, never prints a second graph beside an SEO plugin's, and never leaves your site to look anything up.
fixer.entity_graph.search_template_label: Your site's search address, with {search_term_string} where the search words go
changes.remove_on_delete: Remove my changes when I delete the plugin
changes.deactivation_note: Deactivating the plugin keeps these changes on record, but the site stops serving them until the plugin is active again. Deleting it removes them only if the box above is checked.
network.notice: This plugin is network activated. Each site in the network connects and fixes on its own, and activating it one site at a time is supported.
plugin.row_note: Deactivating keeps your changes on record and stops serving them until you activate again.
preview.choose_signal: Choose an answer for each question, or leave all three as not chosen.
preview.writes: Settings of {tooling} that will be changed
fixer.robots_directives.theme: The theme prints {directives} on {path} itself. This module cannot change theme code, so ask whoever looks after the theme.
fixer.entity_graph.invalid_graph: The graph did not pass the module's own structural check: {problems}.
fixer.entity_graph.logo_needed: Yoast SEO prints an organization only when it has a logo from the media library. Choose one in the logo field, or set it in Yoast, then preview again.
fixer.entity_graph.founding_date_label: Founding date (year, year and month, or full date)
fixer.entity_graph.contact_type_label: Kind of contact, such as customer service
fixer.entity_graph.leaders_label: Founders or leaders, one name per line
fixer.entity_graph.pages_label: Pages that tell visitors who you are
fixer.entity_graph.logo_hint: The address of an https image, or the number of an image in your media library.
diagnostic.cdn.unreachable: This module could not request your own home page, so it could not compare anything.
diagnostic.cdn.row: {agent} was answered {status}, where a browser was answered {normal}.
diagnostic.cdn.result.clean: Your home page answered every AI crawler's User-Agent the way it answered a browser.
diagnostic.cdn.result.blocked: These crawlers were answered differently from a browser: {agents}.
diagnostic.cdn.result.hint: The answers suggest a network in front of the site: {sources}.
diagnostic.cdn.caveat: A request from your own server is not a real crawler's request. A CDN or firewall that decides by a crawler's address range will answer the real one differently, so read this as a hint and not as proof.
diagnostic.js_only.row: {path}: about {percent} percent of the page's own text is in the HTML before any script runs.
diagnostic.js_only.result.clean: The pages checked carry their text in the HTML before any script runs.
diagnostic.js_only.result.flagged: {count} pages carry little of their own text until a script runs.
diagnostic.js_only.nothing_to_compare: There were no published pages with enough text to compare.
diagnostic.js_only.cause.app_shell: The page is an empty application shell that a script fills in.
diagnostic.js_only.cause.framework: The page is rendered by a JavaScript framework in the browser.
diagnostic.js_only.cause.noscript_fallba: The text is only in a noscript fallback, which is a sign the page expects scripts.
diagnostic.js_only.cause.builder_animati: A page builder reveals the content with an animation script.
diagnostic.js_only.cause.lazy_content: A lazy-loading script holds back part of the content.
fixer.dates.flag.modified_before_publish: WordPress recorded a modified date earlier than the published date. The published date is used instead; the date stored in WordPress is not changed.
fixer.dates.flag.modified_in_future: WordPress recorded a modified date in the future. The published date is used instead; the date stored in WordPress is not changed.
fixer.robots_directives.could_not_look: This module could not read any of your pages from the server, so it cannot say which of them carry these directives.
privacy.policy: This site uses the Readiness Index plugin. When an administrator connects it, the plugin sends this site's address, the versions of the plugin and WordPress, and a connection key to readinessindex.io, operated by TEN7, so the service can scan the site and return its score. It sends no information about visitors or users and collects no analytics. The plugin also requests this site's own pages from this site's own address, to check that a change it made is live. Terms and privacy policy: https://readinessindex.io/terms and https://readinessindex.io/privacy.
